title: Platform Detail Page Settings

fields.label: Intro Title
fields.name: platform_intro_title
fields.instructions: Main title for the intro section (appears after hero).

fields.label: Intro Text
fields.name: platform_intro_text
fields.instructions: Introductory text displayed below the title. Use line breaks to create multiple paragraphs.

fields.label: Show Not Found Message
fields.name: platform_show_not_found
fields.instructions: Enable to display a 'not found' message instead of the page content.

fields.label: Not Found Title
fields.name: platform_not_found_title
fields.instructions: Title for the not found message.

fields.label: Not Found Text
fields.name: platform_not_found_text
fields.instructions: Text for the not found message.
fields.default_value: It is possible that the page has moved or changed or may no longer be available. Please check the page address and try again.

fields.label: Featured Image
fields.name: platform_featured_image
fields.instructions: Featured image displayed alongside the body copy in the image/text section.

fields.label: Body Copy
fields.name: platform_body_copy
fields.instructions: Main body copy displayed in the image/text section (left side, 40% width).

fields.label: Benefits
fields.name: platform_benefits
fields.instructions: Benefits content displayed in the left column (50% width). Supports HTML and lists.

fields.label: Features
fields.name: platform_features
fields.instructions: Features content displayed in the right column (50% width). Supports HTML and lists.

description: Fields for Platform Detail pages (sub-pages of Decision Cloud). Configure intro section, content, benefits, features, and featured image.
